visual_conclusion: These three images are one continuous Mega Toxicroak design progression. The core silhouette and identity remain the same: bulky amphibian brawler, oversized curved forearm poison blades, heavy spikes, large red throat sac, and aggressive crouched stance. The venom-drip image is a refinement request applied to that same concept, and the final sprite sheet carries the same design into front/back and shiny views.
quality_notes: The green/purple venom is a design refinement, not a separate form identity.
Normal and shiny views are palette variants of the same Mega concept.
Keep front/back anatomy and toxin-blade placement consistent at DS scale.
Any previously approved Mercury Mega Toxicroak art remains protected until explicit replacement approval.
